hair_features.reason: Dark brows remain with cap-covered hairline and no added glasses, beard or clearly defined moustache; existing upper-lip/mouth shading is not amplified into invented facial hair.

collar_fit.reason: The navy high collar and small gold collar detail fit the short broad neck without pinching, floating cloth, a long neck column or a cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The person retains a viewer-left reserved expression, white/light-gray topped navy peaked cap with dark band, gold front badge and glossy visor, dark brows and navy high-collared uniform with a small gold collar detail. Both note rows contain TWO irregular compact source-scale groups with appropriate separation and relative lengths, not multiplied dots or an extra lower-left stroke. Blank lower paper and the small right-edge tab remain, with the complete photographic backing.
entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA is 2048x2048 with extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=1908431, 252=1444548, 253=679551, 254=224 and 255=0. Complete white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency around the complete card/frame/note silhouette without visible interior holes, lost backing or a working-matte halo. Internal 252-254 values alone are not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: Cap shadow and the 65x67 size leave very fine upper-lip hair detail unresolved; exact badge motifs and note glyphs are unreadable. Approval relies on the clearly visible source groups, clothing, pose, collar and alpha, not guessed fine text.
